title: Cy Twombly: Paesaggio Poster

description.main: This poster reproduces Paesaggio (1986), a painting by Cy Twombly shown in the 2025 exhibition Cy Twombly at Gagosian's 980 Madison Avenue gallery in New York. The painting belongs to a group of green-toned canvases Twombly made at his studio in Bassano in Teverina, Italy, in the 1980s.
description.extended:
This poster reproduces Paesaggio (1986), a painting by Cy Twombly shown in the 2025 exhibition Cy Twombly at Gagosian's 980 Madison Avenue gallery in New York.

The painting belongs to a group of green-toned canvases Twombly made at his studio in Bassano in Teverina, Italy, between 1981 and 1986, working from the landscape around him. Thinned, liquid paint builds up in layers so that water, earth, and air read as loosely bound rather than as separate elements, with color and texture carrying the sense of place rather than describing it directly.

Twombly (1928–2011) settled in Italy in the late 1950s and worked between Bassano in Teverina and Gaeta for much of his later career, moving from the classical references of his Roman years toward the more abstract, landscape-based paintings of the 1980s. Paesaggio belongs to that later group.
description.artist_bio: Cy Twombly (1928–2011) was an American painter, sculptor, draughtsman, and photographer born in Lexington, Virginia. He settled in Italy in the late 1950s, working from studios in Rome, Bassano in Teverina, and Gaeta. His later paintings moved between classical reference and a more abstract engagement with landscape, color, and material.
description.exhibition_context: Cy Twombly ran at Gagosian's 980 Madison Avenue gallery in New York from January 23 to March 22, 2025.

notes: Poster reproduces Paesaggio (1986, oil and acrylic on wood panel, 69 5/8 x 50 5/8 inches / 176.8 x 128.6 cm per the poster's own caption), from a series of green paintings Twombly made at Bassano in Teverina, Italy, 1981-1986. Produced 2025 for the exhibition Cy Twombly at Gagosian, 980 Madison Avenue, New York, January 23-March 22, 2025.
